City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  August 02, 2021

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was a call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833; Meeting  ID:
960 5053 9618 Passcode: 017243 at 9:30 am.

  Members Present:  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman City Attorney’s Office
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Office

  Staff Present:  Trinidad, Juan, Public Works
  Maldonado, Stephanie, Parks and Rec Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of July 26, 2021, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. ACCO Engineered Systems – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  repair services to the City in the amount of $1,285.00. Motion carried unanimously.

3. Joe Schutte’s Complete Pool and Spa Service – Executive session to discuss recommend
  payment for providing pool maintenance services at Edward Vincent Jr. Park in the amount of
  $2,640.00. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 9:40 a.m. Adjournment
